newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states condemn Khobar car bomb attack and support Saudi Arabia's fight against terrorism.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan to inaugurate a new heart medical centre on Wednesday.
- Gulf Arab states reject Turkish buffer zone in northern Iraq.
- Saudi Arabian tourists spent 25 billion riyals abroad last year: expert.
- Taiwan agricultural experts helping in crops research.
- Saudi Arabian airlines will reduce by 30 to 40 percent its ticket rates to Europe and the Americas starting mid September.
